name: Classic Fantasy
summary: Heroic journeys through rival kingdoms, dangerous roads, ancient ruins, and bright fellowship.

patterns.name: Border Kingdoms
patterns.summary: Defend small realms where wilderness, monsters, and old grudges meet.

patterns.name: War of Heirs
patterns.summary: Choose loyalties and shape a succession struggle across a divided crown.

patterns.name: Ruins of the Ancient Empire
patterns.summary: Explore fallen wonders whose treasures can remake the living world.

name: Dark Fantasy
summary: Desperate people confront curses, corrupt powers, and choices whose victories always carry a price.

patterns.name: Dying Marches
patterns.summary: A sunless border holds its harvest behind oath-bound gates. Recover a stolen dawn bell, expose the cost of protection and choose who may claim the last safe fields.

patterns.name: Witch Principalities
patterns.summary: Three witch houses divide a valley by inherited curses. Investigate a broken naming pact, rescue its unnamed children and decide whether the houses retain their bargains.

patterns.name: Plague Pilgrimage
patterns.summary: A procession seeks a cure carried by a living saint. Separate disease from imposed penance, protect the sick and choose the conditions under which the cure is shared.

name: Space Opera
summary: A daring crew explores ancient gates, contested systems, and civilizations poised for change.

patterns.name: Voidwake Archipelago
patterns.summary: Cross isolated star islands linked by unstable gates and old promises.

patterns.name: Sunforge Hegemony
patterns.summary: Resist or reform an empire powered by engineered suns and rigid duty.

patterns.name: Nightglass Frontier
patterns.summary: Build a future along a dark frontier filled with relics and rival crews.

name: Cyberpunk
summary: Street crews plan dangerous operations against systems that turn identity, loyalty, and survival into commodities.

patterns.name: Rainline Mutual
patterns.summary: A flooded district builds its own utility network. Rescue tenants, prove deliberate outages and decide who owns the repair.

patterns.name: Glass House
patterns.summary: A corporate clinic sells stolen identities as insurance. Protect witnesses, trace consent records and choose how to expose the exchange.

patterns.name: Ghost Transit
patterns.summary: An abandoned metro carries a missing courier's memories. Follow the signal, protect displaced sleepers and decide who may copy a person.

name: Post-Apocalypse
summary: Communities rebuild among ruined roads, scarce resources, strange hazards, and the legacies of a lost age.

patterns.name: Dustroad Convoy
patterns.summary: A supply convoy must cross a broken causeway before a dust front. Rescue isolated travelers, bargain for passage and decide whether its reserves belong to buyers or communities.

patterns.name: Seed Vault
patterns.summary: A sealed greenhouse offers a harvest at the price of an old isolation protocol. Recover clean seed, investigate contamination and decide who may plant beyond its walls.

patterns.name: Last Grid
patterns.summary: A failing power station can warm one settlement through the coming freeze. Repair its controls, expose unequal rationing and decide how the remaining heat is shared.

name: Gothic Horror
summary: Investigators uncover intimate tragedies, seductive secrets, and monsters hidden behind respectable doors.

patterns.name: Mourning County
patterns.summary: A village inherits an estate whose funeral bells ring for living heirs. Investigate a buried promise, protect the named families and choose how to end its obligation.

patterns.name: Velvet Court
patterns.summary: A respectable court conceals a blood debt behind invitations and charitable care. Preserve witnesses, confront its patrons and decide whether a public confession can break the contract.

patterns.name: Drowned Choir
patterns.summary: A cathedral beneath the reservoir sings through the town's wells. Find the missing choir, restore a safe water route and decide who must remember the drowned parish.

name: Mythic Antiquity
summary: Heroes face prophecy, divine rivalry, and legendary trials in a world where every deed becomes a story.

patterns.name: Warring Poleis
patterns.summary: Two cities read a reversed river as a promise of victory. Recover the omen's hidden condition and decide whether civic honor can mean a shared rescue.

patterns.name: Islands of the Odyssey
patterns.summary: A homeward crew encounters the voice of a companion it abandoned. Free a captive storm and restore a truthful story before the beacon will lead them home.

patterns.name: Underworld Frontier
patterns.summary: A living visitor follows an unfinished request across death's border. Face unequal judgment, choose the cost of a farewell and return without commanding the dead.

name: Weird West
summary: Drifters, settlers, and outlaws confront supernatural debts across a frontier that remembers every injustice.

patterns.name: Cursed Frontier
patterns.summary: A fence across a promised mourning road wakes a flood rider. Recover the shared agreement, evacuate threatened families and restore a passage people can actually use.

patterns.name: Ghost Railway
patterns.summary: An extra midnight carriage carries workers erased from the timetable. Repair its brake lantern, find an unpaid builder and bring the lost crew to a present-day platform.

patterns.name: Occult Boomtown
patterns.summary: New gold pulses with miners' heartbeats and poisons the town well. Test the living vein, rescue lower-gallery workers and choose a livelihood above the dangerous shaft.

name: Urban Fantasy
summary: Ordinary obligations collide with hidden courts, magical neighborhoods, and bargains that reshape city life.

patterns.name: Hidden Courts
patterns.summary: A missing treaty ending traps readers inside an after-hours library. Navigate rival courts, retrieve a page due tomorrow and reclaim memories demanded as exit tribute.

patterns.name: Monster Districts
patterns.summary: A daylight inspection threatens a tower shared by ordinary and nocturnal neighbors. Repair its shades and demonstrate safety while protecting residents' private identities.

patterns.name: Municipal Magic Conspiracy
patterns.summary: A private spell extension erases streets from emergency maps. Follow its payment trail, rescue a caller on a lost route and restore names chosen by residents.

name: Cosmic Investigation
summary: Investigators pursue impossible evidence while knowledge, isolation, and mounting pressure threaten everyone involved.

patterns.name: Coastal University
patterns.summary: An observatory predicts the disappearance of named archive pages. Compare independent tide records, trace a recent transmitter repair and stop harmful alignment without destroying proof.

patterns.name: Polar Expedition
patterns.summary: A warm geometric cavity beneath unmelted ice erases measured time. Use control samples and external clocks, count the unlisted crew and find a cold route out.

patterns.name: Decaying Metropolis
patterns.summary: An emergency switchboard forgets streets at a repeating interval. Compare passenger journeys, isolate the erasing feed and restore routes without forcing one shared memory.

name: Age of Sail
summary: Crews chase rumors across dangerous seas where empires, free captains, storms, and living myths compete.

patterns.name: Pirate Archipelago
patterns.summary: Free captains hold lifeboats needed by a stranded reef crew. Settle an earlier wreck debt, launch a rescue and choose whether spoils include future lifesaving duties.

patterns.name: Imperial Trade War
patterns.summary: Civilian treatment crates face a blockade backed by forged papers. Compare orders, deliver to both rival shores and preserve a neutral crew from forced military service.

patterns.name: Mythic Ocean
patterns.summary: A moving island sings names its sailors never offered while a private anchor drags it toward a storm. Free borrowed names, cut the anchor and chart a course the island chooses.

name: Mecha & Kaiju
summary: Pilots and crews defend fragile communities while immense machines, monsters, and personal bonds bear the cost.

patterns.name: Defense Metropolis
patterns.summary: A coastal shield threatens its own civilian shelters. Evacuate the lower city, mark a narrow firing arc and face the actual cost of defense.

patterns.name: Colony Rebellion
patterns.summary: A fuel convoy conceals civilian air. Verify quotas, protect neutral repairs and win independent access without destroying shared life support.

patterns.name: Machine-Wreck Frontier
patterns.summary: A giant marked for scrap still carries living pilots. Wake its crew, negotiate salvage consent and find a route for two answering frames.
